conflicts.fact: Single-seat/trip probabilities derived from Kamau's tally: P(full bus)=8/20=0.4 vs. P(seat filled)=7/10 vs. 10/14. The tally data gives a mean of about 10.6 passengers, so 7/10 and 10/14 are not derived from the data and conflict with each other.
conflicts.versions: Lesson 4 and 8: P(randomly chosen seat occupied)=10/14≈0.71. Lesson 7: seat filled is 14/20=7/10, treating the 14 as a count of trips, and says 'we estimated earlier 7/10' with Lesson 6 cited as the source, but Lesson 6 never derives it. Lessons 1, 2, 6: P(full bus)=0.4. Lesson 6 also treats 0.4 as the probability each trip is full.
